rules.title: 2026 standard relocation assistance payment for owner move-in and Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: Owners who evict tenants for owner move-in, or to take a property off the rental market under the Ellis Act, must pay relocation assistance. Starting January 1, 2026, the standard payment is $19,413, a 1.5% inflation adjustment.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span:
The standard relocation assistance payment will increase to
$19,413
.

enacted_date.quoted_span: At its October 16, 2025 Special Meeting, the Rent Board approved relocation assistance payment increases

effective_dates.quoted_span: that will go into effect on January 1, 2026

coverage.notes: Applies to owner move-in evictions (Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance) and Ellis Act evictions (Ellis Implementation Ordinance).

rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted for owner move-in or so the owner can remove the property from the rental housing market (Ellis Act).
rules.interaction: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation payments as the Rent Ordinance. Both are indexed yearly to the 12-month CPI-U increase for the San Francisco-Oakland-San Jose region, as published by the Rent Board.

rules.title: 2026 additional relocation assistance payment for qualifying households
rules.requirement: Qualifying households evicted for owner move-in or under the Ellis Act get an additional relocation payment. Starting January 1, 2026, this payment is $6,471.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span:

.

enacted_date.quoted_span: At its October 16, 2025 Special Meeting, the Rent Board approved relocation assistance payment increases

effective_dates.quoted_span: that will go into effect on January 1, 2026

coverage.notes: Only for 'qualifying households' (the document does not define them), in owner move-in and Ellis Act evictions.

rules.coverage_text: Qualifying households evicted for owner move-in or under the Ellis Act.
rules.interaction: This payment is on top of the standard relocation payment. It is indexed yearly to CPI-U under the Rent and Ellis Implementation Ordinances.
